source.note: Word list extracted from the Teacher Language Bank PDF; partners, meanings, notes, and mini tests are LEEA enrichment fields.

mini_test_format.common_partner_choice: Choose the natural phrase that uses the academic word.
mini_test_format.meaning_check: Choose the type/category of the academic word.
mini_test_format.use_it: Write or say a short classroom sentence using the word.

mini_test.prompt: Which phrase sounds natural with "accuracy"?
